meta.description: Nuxt 4 + BFF Node layer production template with security middleware, structured logging, unified API format, and integration tests.

auth.demoHint: Demo mode: any email with the password password1234 will sign you in.

overview.title: Template demos
overview.heading: Nuxt 4 + BFF Production Template
overview.subheading: The frontend only calls its own Node layer, which then calls external APIs. Security, logging, unified formats, and tests are all built in.

security.title: Security
security.body: Security headers, CORS allowlist, rate limiting, CSRF, and body guards across six middleware layers.

logging.title: Structured logging
logging.body: Pino JSON output with a requestId on every log line for full request tracing.

format.title: Unified format
format.body: Success and failure always share one shape, so the frontend needs no defensive parsing.

bff.title: BFF architecture
bff.body: Upstream tokens never leave the Node layer — the browser never sees them.

testing.title: Integration tests
testing.body: Vitest across unit, component, and SSR end-to-end layers, with MSW intercepting upstream APIs.

rwd.title: Responsive
rwd.body: Tailwind v4 CSS-first theming, fluid typography, and flicker-free dark mode.

api.title: Two API calling styles
api.body: Declarative (SSR) vs imperative, with pagination and the unified error format.

login.title: Sign-in flow
login.body: BFF auth demo: the token stays in the Node layer, the browser only gets an httpOnly cookie.

demo.title: API calling styles
demo.description: This page uses both wrappers: declarative for the list (SSR), imperative for button actions.
demo.methodBDescription: Called inside event handlers — ideal for form submissions and deletions.

home.title: Home
home.placeholder: This is the template default home page — replace it with your own. All demo pages live under /demo and exist only in development.
